row:
Welcome! This channel is all about massage techniques and small business advice. Whether you are new to massage or a seasoned vet everyone could use ideas to help enhance their massage or small business. We will upload a new video weekly. We will be looking at a wide variety of techniques including  swedish massage, hot stone massage, prenatal massage, thai massage, shiatsu massage just to name a few.  We will also be discussing different topics that plague small business owners.

Thank you for taking the time to watch and we hope you enjoy!
